synopsis: The cited current edition of FAA AC 25.1309-1B concerns system design and analysis and is dated 2024 [f7628]. Chapter 10 and the glossary agree that it and AC 00-72 accept satisfactory service history as evidence for systems sufficiently similar to a fielded system, provided differences are identified and justified [f7630, f14659]. For certain compliance arguments, the applicant must establish similarity in relevant attributes and explain why the reference history applies [f7925]. Tool or service history can also contribute to confidence in development tools when version, operational environment, maturity and usage are similar; this is framed as one contributor, not a standalone assurance [f7631].

relations.note: Glossary restates Chapter 10's conditional acceptance of satisfactory service history.
Both condition service-history evidence on relevant similarity and justification of differences.
Same conditional acceptance; Chapter 10 specifies applicant responsibility and certain compliance arguments.
